mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.user_id, r.salon_id, r.reservation_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.user_name, s.salon_name FROM Reviews r JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = r.salon_id WHERE r.salon_id = #{salonId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reviews WHERE salon_id = #{salonId}

SELECT r.review_id, r.user_id, r.salon_id, r.reservation_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.user_name, s.salon_name FROM Reviews r JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = r.salon_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.review_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, r.salon_id AS salonId, r.service_id AS serviceId, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.status, s.salon_name AS salonName, se.service_name AS serviceName FROM Reservations r JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = r.salon_id JOIN Services se ON se.service_id = r.service_id LEFT JOIN Reviews rv ON rv.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.salon_id = #{salonId} AND r.status = 'completed' AND rv.review_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.reservation_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reservations r LEFT JOIN Reviews rv ON rv.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.salon_id = #{salonId} AND r.status = 'completed' AND rv.review_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Reviews (user_id, salon_id, reservation_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{userId}, #{salonId}, #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
